metadata.question: Does tropospheric nitrogen dioxide (NO2) levels in Chongqing, China increase during April 20-May 12, 2020 compared to February 10-25, 2020?

data.raw_code: To answer this question, we need to analyze tropospheric NO2 levels in Chongqing, China during two time periods: 1. February 10-25, 2020 (before COVID-19 lockdowns likely eased) 2. April 20-May 12, 2020 (during/post-lockdown period when economic activity may have resumed) We'll use Sentinel-5P NO2 data which provides tropospheric NO2 column density measurements. The key band is 'NO2_column_number_density'. Steps: 1. Define geometry for Chongqing (using a point or polygon around the city center) 2. Get NO2 data for both periods 3. Check if collections are empty (C1) 4. Compute mean NO2 for each period 5. Check if valid pixels exist after masking (C2) 6. Validate results (C3 if NaN/invalid) 7. Compare values and determine answer Key considerations: - Use appropriate cloud/quality masking for Sentinel-5P - Check for missing data and try fallback if needed - Validate results (NO2 should be positive, typically 0-0.0001 mol/m² for tropospheric column) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Chongqing geometry (central urban area) const chongqing = ee.Geometry.Point([106.552, 29.563]).buffer(20000); // 20km buffer around city center // 2. Define time periods const period1_start = '2020-02-10'; const period1_end = '2020-02-25'; const period2_start = '2020-04-20'; const period2_end = '2020-05-12'; // 3. Function to get and process NO2 data async function getNO2Mean(startDate, endDate, periodName) { let collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .select('NO2_column_number_density') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(chongqing); const count = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`${periodName} Images: ${count}`); if (count === 0) { return {mean: null, pixelCount: 0, valid: false}; } // Create mean composite const meanImage = collection.mean(); // Get pixel count and mean value const stats = meanImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.mean(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: chongqing, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const pixelCount = ee.Number(stats.get('NO2_column_number_density_count')).getInfo(); const meanValue = ee.Number(stats.get('NO2_column_number_density_mean')).getInfo(); return { mean: meanValue, pixelCount: pixelCount, valid: (meanValue !== null && pixelCount > 0) }; } // 4. Get data for both periods const period1 = await getNO2Mean(period1_start, period1_end, "Feb 10-25, 2020"); const period2 = await getNO2Mean(period2_start, period2_end, "Apr 20-May 12, 2020"); // 5. Check for missing data (C1) if (!period1.valid && period1.pixelCount === 0) { console.log("No valid data for Period 1"); console.log("C1"); return; } if (!period2.valid && period2.pixelCount === 0) { console.log("No valid data for Period 2"); console.log("C1"); return; } // 6. Check for no valid pixels (C2) if (period1.pixelCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels for Period 1 after processing"); console.log("C2"); return; } if (period2.pixelCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels for Period 2 after processing"); console.log("C2"); return; } console.log(`Period 1 (Feb): Mean NO2 = ${period1.mean?.toExponential(2)} mol/m², Pixels = ${period1.pixelCount}`); console.log(`Period 2 (Apr-May): Mean NO2 = ${period2.mean?.toExponential(2)} mol/m², Pixels = ${period2.pixelCount}`); // 7. Validate results (C3) if (period1.mean === null || period2.mean === null || isNaN(period1.mean) || isNaN(period2.mean) || period1.mean < 0 || period2.mean < 0) { console.log("Invalid calculation results"); console.log("C3"); return; } // 8. Compare values and determine answer const percentChange = ((period2.mean - period1.mean) / period1.mean) * 100; console.log(`Change: ${percentChange.toFixed(1)}%`); if (period2.mean > period1.mean) { console.log("A"); // Yes, NO2 increased } else { console.log("B"); // No, NO2 did not increase } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
